title: progress declaration
description: What a caller declares inside payload.progress at any of the four doors. Every member here is read at a point of decision in run.py; the pipeline document named by intent.workflow_ref carries what belongs to the unit rather than to this arrival of it. There is deliberately no member by which a caller may raise its own ceiling, choose its executor, name a model or see a criterion.

decision.description: What the person or system in front of the release gate returns. 'none' means nobody answers and the gate reaches its deadline.

decision_body.description: Present on edit: the artifact the decider substitutes for the proposed one.

passes_on_iteration.description: The iteration at which the candidate first satisfies the criterion. It stands for what the world returns, not for what the unit declares: the loop's own bound is stages.develop.iterations_permitted in the pipeline document.

verify_outcome.description: What post-release verification returns. fail is what walks the compensation register backwards.

schedule.description: Present at the schedule door only. unit_ref, recurrence, starts_at, timezone and catch_up are the scheduling capability's own ScheduleDeclaration members.
